name: automattic/vip-governance
description: A WordPress plugin that adds governance to the block editor

scripts.test-gutenberg: npx wp-env run cli --config=.wp-env.gutenberg.json --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/vip-governance-plugin env GOVERNANCE_TEST_GUTENBERG=1 ./vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist
scripts.test-multisite-gutenberg: npx wp-env run cli --config=.wp-env.gutenberg.json --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/vip-governance-plugin env GOVERNANCE_TEST_GUTENBERG=1 ./vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit/multisite.xml
